items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: We have a beautiful rapport in the band... Marty just says, “Okay we’re going to do this” and then one-two, off we go.

ctx.x: Wow. Well one thing you said about the band and this CD, our jazz does not rely on arrangements or even preparatory discussions before we swing into a tune.

Well that’s true. I can’t believe it but that’s what it is. We have a beautiful rapport in the band, we have fine leadership. Marty just says, “Okay we’re going to do this” and then one-two, off we go. And then for the endings, every once in a while he’ll throw a firehouse ending in on you and you just have a keep listening and you can watch him. Sometimes the bell of his horn will come up a little bit or his eyebrow will arch. You can tell.
Okay now you just used a term that I’m not familiar with. A firehouse ending?
